headline: Asda Appoints Former Morrisons Chief David Potts as New Boss
summary: British supermarket chain Asda appointed former Morrisons executive David Potts to take charge of the firm with immediate effect as part of a leadership shake-up.
why: Asda is a major player in the highly competitive UK supermarket sector, and executive changes at large retail chains can signal strategic shifts in pricing, market share, and operational focus.

impacts.name: Asda
impacts.why: Leadership changes introduce new management strategies whose financial outcomes remain uncertain.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
